title: Headwear
description: What a player wears on their head.
fallback: A receiver that does not know a headwear term uses its broader one; with nothing it knows it uses headwrap for a covering and hat otherwise.

terms.label: Gele
terms.description: A Nigerian headwrap, tied high for occasions.

terms.label: Hijab
terms.description: A headscarf covering the hair and neck.

terms.label: Fila
terms.description: A Yoruba cap, soft and often folded to one side.
